name: idc-htan-tnp-sardana
description: DICOM converted cyclic immunofluorescence (CyCIF) and H&E whole slide images of a single formalin- fixed paraffin-embedded colorectal cancer specimen from the Human Tumor Atlas Network (HTAN) SARDANA Trans-Network Project (TNP). The dataset comprises one H&E section and one adjacent CyCIF section imaged with ~20 markers targeting immune, epithelial, and stromal cell populations. Please see the HTAN-TNP-SARDANA Zenodo page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
